description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files within a specific directory in a project to detect usage of raw window.open calls outside a set of allowed call sites. It scans project files, checks for disallowed window.open calls, and reports violations.

methods.name: asPropertyAccess
methods.description: Checks if an expression is a property access expression.

methods.name: isRawWindowOpenCall
methods.description: Determines if a call expression is a raw window.open call.
